program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((h (rows g))
               (w (cols g))
               (dots (find-color g 1)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc dot)
                     (let ((r (fst dot))
                           (c (snd dot)))
                       (let ((g2 (reduce (lambda (a c2) (set-cell a r c2 1))
                                         acc
                                         (range 0 w))))
                         (let ((g3 (reduce (lambda (a r2) (set-cell a r2 c 1))
                                           g2
                                           (range 0 h))))
                           (let ((g4 (set-cell g3 r c 2)))
                             (reduce (lambda (a d)
                                       (let ((nr (+ r (fst d)))
                                             (nc (+ c (snd d))))
                                         (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
                                             (set-cell a nr nc 3)
                                             a)))
                                     g4
                                     (list (list -1 -1)
                                           (list -1 1)
                                           (list 1 -1)
                                           (list 1 1))))))))
                   g
                   dots))))
